en: The postcard features two anthropomorphized chicks dressed in traditional folk costumes. The chick on the left wears a blue jacket, red pants, and a top hat, holding a pussy willow branch. The chick on the right wears a distinctive skirt and embroidered shirt, also holding a pussy willow branch. There is a festive and possibly Easter-related atmosphere. The background is simple and neutral. At the bottom, there is a greeting in stylized script.
